title: ZinaLog Notifications
description: Schema for notifications.json, the remote notification feed consumed by self-hosted ZinaLog installations.

version.description: Schema/format version of this file. Increment only on breaking structural changes.

id.description: Unique identifier. Must never be reused for a different notification.

expiresAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp, or null if it never expires.

minVersion.description: Minimum ZinaLog version this notification applies to, or null for no lower bound.

maxVersion.description: Maximum ZinaLog version this notification applies to, or null for no upper bound.

url.description: HTTPS URL for additional information, or null.

releaseVersion.description: Version number associated with a release notification (used when type is "release").
